items.title: AI推理平台认证绕过可未授权RCE
items.title_zh: AI推理平台认证绕过可未授权RCE
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者可绕过认证获取管理员权限，并借YAML接口执行代码；已观测在野利用
items.action_zh: 立即升级修复版本，轮换API密钥并排查异常管理员
items.repro_note: 调用from-yaml接口提交恶意YAML创建后端
items.impact_scope: AI推理平台，可致集群与密钥失陷
items.description: The bypass allowed unauthenticated administrative access, including user and model changes, persistent administrator API-key creation, disclosure of worker and cloud-provider secrets, and code execution through POST /v2/inference-backends/from-yaml. Exploitation was observed in the wild against a 2.1.1 deployment.

items.title: Comfast路由器路径遍历可读任意文件
items.title_zh: Comfast路由器路径遍历可读任意文件
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者可经Multipart解析路径穿越，读取设备任意文件
cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.action_zh: 关注厂商固件修复，临时限制Web管理面公网访问
items.repro_note: 经Web管理面Multipart解析入口构造穿越路径读取文件
items.impact_scope: SOHO路由器Web管理面，常暴露公网
items.description: A vulnerability was detected in Comfast CF-WR632AX 2.6.0.1. Affected by this vulnerability is an unknown functionality of the file /usr/bin/webmgnt of the component Multipart Parser. Performing a manipulation of the argument filename results in path traversal. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: Edimax路由器命令注入可远程执行
items.title_zh: Edimax路由器命令注入可远程执行
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者经/goform/mp参数注入系统命令，可控制设备
items.action_zh: 关注厂商修复，限制管理面公网访问并排查异常进程
items.repro_note: 向/goform/mp接口提交恶意参数触发系统命令拼接
items.impact_scope: SOHO路由器Web管理接口，常暴露公网
items.description: A flaw has been found in Edimax BR-6208AC 1.32. Affected by this vulnerability is an unknown functionality of the file /goform/mp. Executing a manipulation can lead to command injection. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: 容器沙箱平台越权致跨租户命令执行
items.title_zh: 容器沙箱平台越权致跨租户命令执行
items.summary_zh: 低权限认证用户借未认证provisioner跨租户读文件、密钥并执行命令
items.action_zh: 隔离并鉴权provisioner接口，升级修复并轮换密钥
items.repro_note: 低权限账号从自身沙箱探测未认证provisioner的租户API
items.impact_scope: 多租户容器沙箱，横向跨租户风险
items.description: A low-privileged authenticated user who can execute commands in their own sandbox can reach other tenants' sandbox APIs, access their files and secrets, execute commands in active sandboxes, and enumerate, create, or delete sandboxes through the unauthenticated provisioner without knowing administrator, database, or MinIO credentials.

items.title: vtenext密码重置认证绕过可接管账户
items.title_zh: vtenext密码重置认证绕过可接管账户
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者已知用户名即可改密，接管未启2FA管理员账户
items.action_zh: 升级至25.02.1；为管理员启用2FA并审计重置日志
items.repro_note: 访问/hub/rpwd.php的change_password动作并指定用户名
items.impact_scope: CRM系统，可接管管理员账户
items.description: vtenext 25.02 before 25.02.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to change any account password via hub/rpwd.php without token verification. Attackers knowing a valid user_name can send action=change_password to RecoverPwd::displayChangePwd() and log in as administrators lacking two-factor authentication.

items.title: IBM Watson语音服务UAF可致RCE
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者可触发释放后重用，可能导致任意代码执行
items.action_zh: 升级Watson语音服务Cartridge至修复版本
items.repro_note: 向语音服务接口发送构造请求触发UAF，需进一步定位参数
items.impact_scope: 企业语音服务组件，内网部署
items.description: IBM Watson Speech Services Cartridge 4.0.0 through 5.4.0 could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code due to a use-after-free vulnerability.

items.title: VitaFit云API认证绕过可劫持会话
items.title_zh: VitaFit云API认证绕过可劫持会话
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者提交受害者社交账号标识即可获取完整登录会话
items.action_zh: 升级至2026-10-30后版本，校验三方账号归属
items.repro_note: 向/front/login/sns/提交已知绑定标识，缺身份提供方校验
items.impact_scope: 云API账户，跨用户会话劫持
items.description: VitaFit cloud API before 2026-10-30 contained an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows remote attackers to obtain a full session for a victim's account by submitting a linked Google or Facebook account identifier to the POST /front/login/sns/ endpoint without providing proof of ownership from the identity provider.
